decision.reason: [ev-12d2733c5dd3] says only that a vCert upgrade fixes RSA 3072-bit key size for TPP certificate enrollment. It names no Certificate or Issuer field, and nothing else in the section touches this subject ([ev-aa02449851f9]–[ev-10c8b1c28d66]). So the evidence does not support the proposed paths (spec.privateKey.algorithm/size, spec.venafi.tpp) or the condition's scope. Three scope questions stay open: does an unset algorithm also count as RSA, are ClusterIssuers covered, and are CertificateRequests created directly, without a Certificate, also exposed? To settle this we need upstream text (the PR #7498 description, or docs that name the key-size and Venafi TPP issuer fields) stating which configurations hit the bug.
